P.name: Bridge Between
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Awakened Spirit:}} '''Udyr''' has no {{tip|ability|ultimate ability}} and instead has 4 {{tip|ability|basic abilities}} that each incur a {{sti|cd|{{tt|{{fd|1.5}}-second global cooldown|Affected by ability haste}}}} when cast. Each ability grants a ''Stance'' that empowers his basic attacks, and switching ''Stances'' will replace the empowered attacks of the previous ''Stance''.
P.description2:
Periodically, after '''Udyr''' enters a ''Stance'', he can cast it again at no cost after {{fd|0.25}} seconds and within the following 5 seconds to ''Awaken'' it, empowering the ''Stance'' with an additional effect and placing the effect on cooldown.
If '''Udyr''' does not consume the ''Awaken'' cast within the duration and has not switched ''Stances'', his current ''Stance's'' respective ability incurs a {{fd|0.25}}-second cooldown. ''Awakened Spirit'' is placed on full cooldown at the start of the game.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Monk Training:}} After casting an ability, '''Udyr''' empowers his next two {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} within 4 seconds to gain {{sti|{{as|30% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and refund 5% of ''Awakened Spirit's'' '''total''' cooldown, though not if the remaining cooldown is less than 1 second.

Q.name: Wilding Claw
Q.description: {{sbc|Active - Stance:}} '''Udyr''' enters ''Claw Stance'', empowering his next two basic attacks to gain {{sti|range|50}} '''bonus''' range and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}, capped at 15 {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} against {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.leveling: {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|3 to 8 6}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|3.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}|Total Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|3*2 to 8*2 6}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|3.5*2}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
Q.description2: Additionally, '''Udyr''' gains {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} and deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} {{tip|on-hit}} for 4 seconds.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|20 to 80 6}}%}}
{{st|Bonus Physical Damage On-Hit|{{ap|6 to 36 6}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|1 to 2 6}}% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
Q.description3: {{sbc|Recast - Awaken:}} '''Udyr''' gains an additional {{as|{{pp|20 + (70-20)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed|attack speed}}. The empowered attacks deal an additional {{as|{{pp|2 + (4-2)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}} {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.1}}% per 100 '''bonus''' health)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}} {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}}} if used within 4 seconds. '''Udyr's''' next two basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} in any ''Stance'' within 4 seconds are each empowered to strike with lightning{{ft|6 times over 1 second,|every {{tt|{{fd|0.2}} seconds|First strike is applied instantly, while the remaining 5 are applied every 0.2 seconds thereafter}} over 1 second,}}dealing {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}} equal to {{as|{{pp|1.5 + (3-1.5)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}}|health}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.6}}% per 100 AP)}} {{as|of the target's '''maximum''' health}} per hit, chaining to up to 3 nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies and being able to hit the same target multiple times, for a total of {{as|{{pp|1.5*6 + (3*6-1.5*6)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}}|health}} {{as|(+ {{ap|0.6*6}}% per 100 AP)}} {{as|of the target's '''maximum''' health}}. Each lightning strike deals a minimum of {{pp|40 + (160-40)/17*(x-1) for 20}} against {{tip|minions}} and is capped at 15 {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.
Q.cooldown: {{tt|6|Starts on-cast, but recasting refreshes the cooldown}}

W.name: Iron Mantle
W.description: {{sbc|Active - Stance:}} '''Udyr''' enters ''Mantle Stance'', empowering his next two basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} to gain {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|heal}} him for {{as|{{fd|1.2}}% of his '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ 8% AP)}}.
W.description2: Additionally, '''Udyr''' grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for 4 seconds.
W.leveling2: {{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|45 to 145 6}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2 to 3.5 6}}% '''maximum''' health)}}}}
W.description3: {{sbc|Recast - Awaken:}} '''Udyr''' increases the {{tip|shield|shield's}} strength, stacking with the remaining shield from the first cast, and {{tip|heals}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over the next 4 seconds, as well as causes the empowered attacks to instead gain doubled {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|heal}} him for {{as|{{fd|{{ap|1.2*2}}}}% of his '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ {{ap|8*2}}% AP)}}.
W.cooldown: {{tt|6|Starts on-cast, but recasting refreshes the cooldown}}

E.name: Blazing Stampede
E.description: {{sbc|Active - Stance:}} '''Udyr''' enters ''Stampede Stance'', empowering his basic attacks to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and {{tt|{{tip|dash|pounce}} on the target|to 75 units closer than attack range, if Udyr is not closer already (pending for test)}} to {{tip|stun}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds. This cannot affect the same target more than once every few seconds.
E.description2: Additionally, '''Udyr''' becomes {{tip|ghosted}} and gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 4 seconds, which decays to 30% effectiveness over {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
E.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|25 to 55 6}}% {{as|(+ 5% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Decayed Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|25*0.3 to 55*0.3 6}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|5*0.3}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast - Awaken:}} '''Udyr''' gains {{sti|range|75}} '''bonus''' attack range and an additional {{as|{{pp|30 + (40-30)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}}|ms}} {{as|(+ 10% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed|ms}}. He also gains {{tip|cc-immune|immunity to crowd control}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
E.cooldown: {{tt|6|Starts on-cast, but recasting refreshes the cooldown}}

R.name: Wingborne Storm
R.description: {{sbc|Active - Stance:}} '''Udyr''' enters ''Storm Stance'', empowering his next two {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} to deal {{as|{{pp|10 + (40-10)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
R.description2: Additionally, '''Udyr''' summons a blizzard around himself for 4 seconds that deals {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow|slows}} them while they remain within. {{tip|Minions}} take {{pp|50 to 80 for 4|1 to 16|key=%}} damage.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|10 to 50 6}} {{as|(+ {{fd|17.5}}% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|10*8 to 50*8 6}} {{as|(+ {{ap|17.5*8}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|15 to 30 6}}%}}
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast - Awaken:}} '''Udyr''' ends the blizzard if it is active and unleashes a glacial storm for 4 seconds that is able to move on its own, as well as causes the empowered attacks to instead deal their damage to enemies within that storm. The storm applies the same effects as the blizzard but deals {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}} equal to{{ft|{{as|{{pp|8/8 + (14/8-8/8)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}}|health}} {{as|(+ {{ap|3.5/8}}% per 100 AP)}} {{as|of the target's '''maximum''' health}} per tick|{{as|{{pp|8 + (14-8)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}}|health}} {{as|(+ {{fd|3.5}}% per 100 AP)}} {{as|of the target's '''maximum''' health}} over the duration}}and {{tip|slow|slows}} by an additional 5%. Against {{tip|monsters}}, the{{ft|storm's per-tick damage deals a minimum of {{pp|40/8 + (280/8-40/8)/17*(x-1) for 20}} and is capped at {{pp|80/8 + (400/8-80/8)/17*(x-1) for 20}}.|storm deals a minimum '''total''' damage of {{pp|40 + (280-40)/17*(x-1) for 20}} and is capped at {{pp|80 + (400-80)/17*(x-1) for 20}} '''total''' damage.}}
R.description4: The storm grants {{tip|sight}} of its {{tt|surroundings|Does not permeate through terrain or brush}} and prioritizes following the last enemy '''Udyr''' attacked while it was active, then enemy {{tip|champions}}, then non-champions, then '''Udyr'''. The storm can only follow {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies.
R.cooldown: {{tt|6|Starts on-cast, but recasting refreshes the cooldown}}
